Hao Lin: hi all, first day! need help with VPN + MDM and curious where folks pick stickers. also two truths/lie: i played piano growing up, i've never had sushi, i've lived in 3 countries.

Nina (IT): welcome Hao! DM me for the MDM token. VPN is auto-provisioned after device enrollment. drop your serial and i'll queue an image. sticker wall is in the kitchen by the espresso machine. :sparkles:

Aria P.: hey Hao  i'm on eng-sre, happy to be your buddy. sushi seems suspect. :sushi: welcome aboard!

People Ops Bot: Onboarding checklist created for hao.lin 517 https://redwood.internal/onboard/hao.lin 4c6 Tasks: badge, payroll, benefits, mentor intro.

Hao Lin: thanks all! sushi actually was the lie 60a. i'll DM my serial now and pick up stickers at lunch. looking forward to meeting folks.
